decision.summary: A coherent multi-axis offset initiates at index 482 (N↑, E↓, U↓) with sustained deviation in N through 529 and only partial recovery in E/U by end of allowed context (570). No full return to pre-offset baseline is observed on any axis within [445,570]; thus the interval is classified as uncertain. The screened region (480–535) captures the onset and main sustained phase, but the return remains unobserved.

intervals.observation: N: sharp +12-unit jump at 482, sustained high level through 529; E: sharp -15-unit step at 482, then gradual partial recovery from ~510 onward but not back to pre-event level by 529; U: sharp -10-unit drop at 482, followed by slow monotonic recovery, still below pre-event level at 529. Return not observed on E or U within allowed context; N shows no return. Cross-axis coherence supports single multi-component offset, but return is incomplete/ambiguous.
